# Derecho Usage History

## Resource Usage: 1/1/2025 - Present

![](plots/cpu_and_gpu_usage_usage_history_multiyear.png){height=80%}

::: {.notes}
This is the absolute utilization calculated as realized CPU/GPU hours
consumed normalized by theoretical, 24x7 uptime. Importantly, we do
not adjust for maintenance periods in the denominator of this
calculation.
:::

## User & Project Usage: 1/1/2025 - Present

![](plots/cpu_users_and_projects_usage_history_multiyear.png){height=80%}

::: {.notes}
Shows the number of unique users and projects appearing in batch
scheduler logs for the relevant period.  Does not capture login-only
or data-access-only users that have not used the scheduler.
:::
